entries.sourceGenerationPrompt: Create exactly ONE isolated removable metal biomask faithfully matching the NECA Scavage Series13 2015 photographed sculpture/paint in the FIRST attachment. Version A is a source-faithful isolated reconstruction of this licensed toy edition, not a redesign. PRIMARY REFERENCE IS ONLY THE MASKED HEAD IN THE UPPER-LEFT INSET of the white catalog photo. The large MAIN FIGURE is UNMASKED and must NOT supply mask geometry. The package photo only confirms identity; its partly hidden accessory does not authorize hidden surfaces. Preserve the inset's almost frontal slightly downward-facing camera, visibly asymmetric short raised corner points, silver-gray metal sculpt, raised rounded teardrop forehead shield, swept brow, narrow amber eye apertures, sculpted side cheek frames and short stacked/ribbed silver central respirator. Copy visible shape and contours only, including the incomplete/open lower face frame. The green/blue mouth, ivory/yellow tusks and organic mandibles visible beneath this mask are the WEARER, not metallic mask ornaments: remove ALL those anatomical parts and leave their open spaces truly transparent. Remove orange dreadlocks, biological skin, neck, shoulder armor, cannon, necklace, staff and body. The mask may have an open lower center and separate-looking short metallic framing prongs exactly where the inset proves them; do not add tusks, close the open bottom, invent a jaw grille or extend a hidden back. Preserve modest photographed worn silver paint and tiny darker recesses, not invented glyphs/LEDs, extra horns, scars, engravings or ornamental teeth. Neutral source-like toy product-photo material and paint character, not an all-chrome upgrade or fantasy sculpture. Compose a SQUARE transparent canvas with the entire mask SMALL AND CENTERED, its longer axis about75% of canvas size, leaving10-12% or more empty transparent margin on all outer sides. Preserve all tips, no clipping. One isolated complete visible mask only, no additional views, no inset, no text, no logo, no border, no background/floor/shadow/vignette.
